integrity: Integral conclusions are supported by a full-relative homology proof using primitive four-coordinate sphere classes and published intact homology. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: One removed graph edge, not vertex removal or multiple defects; no equivariant splitting. Finite mod-two verifier is corroboration, not an integral proof. Unindexed prior results remain possible.
title: One-edge homotopy stability of demihypercube flag complexes
